_comment: Real speedskatingresults.com response, captured 2026-09-13 for skater_results.php?skater=121536&season=2025&distance=500 (issue #7). Replaces a synthetic fixture whose time field used 'mm:ss.hh' (colon) formatting -- real SSR times use 'm.ss,hh' (dot-separated minutes, comma decimal), e.g. '1.00,28' = 1:00.28. parseSsrTimeValue already handled this correctly (it was written defensively without a real sample); no code change was needed for this format. Also confirms season=2025 (2025/2026 season) is the correct startjaar for these March 2026 races -- season=2026 returns zero results, matching OSTA's semantics.
